message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate crimes based on facts. Facts: Husband repeatedly beats wife, on June 26 2016 he beats and insults, then victim falls into river and drowns. Autopsy shows injuries consistent with assault and neck compression (strangulation) and blunt force. Injuries are light injuries (second degree). Death caused by drowning, but injuries contributed. Likely crimes: intentional homicide? But the death is due to drowning after assault. Could be "故意伤害致人死亡" (intentional injury resulting in death) which is a form of homicide under Chinese law: "故意伤害致人死亡罪". Also "虐待家庭成员罪" (domestic violence) maybe "虐待罪". The example earlier: In first example, they gave "非法携带枪支、弹药、管制刀具、危险物品危及公共安全;寻衅滋事". For domestic violence leading to death, typical charges: "故意伤害致人死亡罪" and "虐待罪". Also possibly "故意杀人罪"? But the intent to kill may not be proven; they used assault leading to death. So likely "故意伤害致人死亡罪" (intentional injury causing death) and "虐待家庭成员罪". In Chinese criminal law, article 260: "虐待家庭成员罪". So answer: 故意伤害致人死亡;虐待家庭成员. Need format: [罪名]故意伤害致人死亡;虐待家庭成员<eoa>. Ensure no extra spaces.
